title: Opposition candidates and critics face pressure before the vote
detail: The pre-election period was marked by arrests, intimidation, and violence that narrowed opposition space and raised concern about whether competition would be meaningfully free.

title: Voting takes place for the 11th Parliamentary Election
detail: Bangladesh held national elections for 300 directly elected parliamentary seats.

title: Awami League wins a landslide victory
detail: The ruling alliance secured an overwhelming majority, while opposition parties rejected the result and alleged major irregularities.

title: The election becomes a reference point for democratic backsliding
detail: The controversy surrounding the vote hardened long-term debate about legitimacy, civic freedom, and the narrowing of competitive politics.
